main_text.p: Credo esse nonnullos manfuetioris inge-nii, qui è ruina Mea minùs creverunt, qui jam stimulos aliquot asperiores & conscientiæ morsus sentiunt, cùm jam facinorum suorum effigiem, & lineamenta quasi expressa in similibus aliquot pœnis agnovere, qui certe vix sperare jam possunt pollices manuum & pedum integros sibi diù manfuros, qui (quasi ungues tantum præscesturi) mihi Robur maximum amputarunt.

Infolentiores vero & contumaciores poteft Deus infolenti quâdam & inufitatâ plaga (velut Corah & illius confortes in Principem simul & Sacerdotem murmurantes) oppri-mere, ut nempe Terræ filii (infima illa & con-temptissima Populi pars) os in illos aperiat, & (justissimo Dominationis male partæ pejus geftæ faftidio) hauriat penitus & absorbeat (ille ipse inquam Populus) cujus maximè fu'cimento[?] subnixi, hæc in Me & Ecclesiam & Statum construxerunt.

Solatium Mihi in Morte præcipuum est illa Pax quam spero cum Deo factam: ad cujus rigidum Tribunal non verebor comparere, & illam causam afferere inter Me & Hostes meos (nullo merito meo infensos) Gladiq tamdiù disputatam, haud dubitans quin illius rectissi-mo judicio istæ omnes argutiæ refellentur, queis (Sophistarum magis quàm Christianorum more) à successu argumenta in causam faciunt, quasi sic Deus oftenderit illam sibi approbari, cujus sapiens Providentia multa sæpe permittit

page.notes: No marginal notes or footnotes on this page. Left and right edges show only paper edge, stains and show-through, which are omitted. "fu'cimento" is printed with an apostrophe-like mark; it is probably a printing error for "fulcimento" and is left as printed. "Gladiq" is printed as shown. Greek running head transcribed in Greek letters as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ. Italic words are judged from the scan and may be incomplete.
